review:
Clover Bonanza is a St Patrick's-themed member of BGaming's Bonanza family. Bright fruits and lucky clovers cascade down the reels, and matching symbols anywhere on screen create wins.

Scatters appear on every reel and pay in any position in the main game; their behaviour changes during the free spins round. As with the rest of the family, a multiplier symbol is the main source of big wins in the bonus, and you can buy Chance x2 to improve your chance of four scatters, or buy the bonus outright where permitted. BGaming rates it high volatility with a 15,000x maximum and a 95.97% RTP. Expect long gaps between free spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 395 spins on average)
